verdict.rationale: First-party API docs describe a `GET /v1/models` endpoint for listing available models and a `GET /v1/models/{model_id}` endpoint for model details. The changelog adds that both now return `max_input_tokens`, `max_tokens`, and a `capabilities` object, so an agent can discover the live catalog and per-model capabilities programmatically. The model ID versioning docs back this up by explaining how the returned IDs are structured. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the endpoint works as documented; also, the OpenAPI probe returned 404, so no machine-readable spec of the endpoint was confirmed.
